D/ [--]POSTVMVS P.F AVG ; R/ VICTOR[IAE AVG]

Copper alloy coin. Sestertius of Postumus (260-269), possibly RIC Vol. 5 part 2 no. 166, mint of Lyon issue of 260-261. Obverse description; bust possibly laureate cuirassed right, bearded. Obverse inscription: [--]POSTVMVS P.F AVG. Reverse description: two Victories facing each other, shield trophy over bound captives between them; exergual line, S C below it.
